about: The real-bugs review test, both stages: score-mc outputs for every comparison and reading, judge checks, exposure rows, the blinding check, session costs and spend.

not_rebuilt.reason: score-mc.ts reads the blinded, judged arm trees (every reviewer finding with its text and the judges' rulings), which hold third-party code excerpts and are not committed; the scored outputs are published as this run's receipts.
They were computed from the judges' and labellers' read sessions, which are not in the repository.

not_rebuilt.what: The exposure rows, clean-arm audits and blinding check (results/stage1/exposure-*.tsv, clean-arm-audit.json, blinding-*.json, stage2/results/exposure-summary.json, clean-arm-audit/, blinding.json)
not_rebuilt.reason: They were read from the review sessions' transcripts, which are not in the repository.

not_rebuilt.what: Session costs and spend (stage2/results/costs.json, stage2/results/spend.json) and the cost tables in report.md and stage2/report.md
not_rebuilt.reason: They come from the metering ledgers and proxy usage logs on the run machines, which are not committed.

not_rebuilt.what: The secondary readings and strata (results/stage1/secondary.json, strata.json)
not_rebuilt.reason: They were computed by a grading script from the judged arm trees, which are not committed.
